annotation.title_clean: Advanced robotics and AI-based systems for automation of tasks
annotation.title_en: Advanced robotics and AI-based systems for automation of tasks
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Agency for Safety and Health at Work (EU-OSHA)
annotation.summary_en: EU-OSHA event page for a 15 March 2023 Brussels seminar on the occupational safety and health implications of advanced robotics, cobots and AI-based task automation. It describes physical, psychosocial and organisational risks, and break-out sessions on regulation, inspections and OSH management, with the aim of drawing policy priorities.
key_provisions_or_claims: Cobots and AI-based systems create both opportunities and risks for occupational safety and health
Risk factors classified as physical, psychosocial and organisational
Opportunities include removing workers from high-risk environments and reducing cognitive workload
Seminar addresses regulation, inspections and OSH management, and sets priorities for EU policymaking
